name: Loki
description: Log aggregation from Grafana Labs: collect logs from your apps and servers and query them in Grafana.

connection.title: Connect to Loki
connection.description: Loki has no web page and no login. Add its URL as a Loki data source in Grafana, and point log shippers (Grafana Alloy, Promtail) at /loki/api/v1/push.

outputs.label: Loki API
outputs.help: GET /ready returns "ready" once Loki has started.

firstLogin.note: Anyone who can reach this URL can read and write your logs, so keep it off a public domain or turn on Password protection for it. Logs are kept for 31 days in the loki_data volume.

features.title: Log aggregation
features.description: Collect logs from apps, containers and servers in one place.

features.title: LogQL queries
features.description: Search and filter logs by label from Grafana.

features.title: Bounded storage
features.description: Old logs are deleted after 31 days.
